feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 November 2026 11:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 13 November 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing tomorrow morning.


##Synopsis##

High pressure over Ireland moving eastwards into Europe.


##Wind##

Northwest 3 or 4, soon backing west, then backing southwest 4 or 5 later in the evening. Increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning, and occasionally 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight becoming slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Isolated showers at first becoming mainly fair this afternoon. Isolated showers again overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, perhaps moderate in showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, increasing 7 in western waters Saturday evening. Decreasing 5 or 6 again later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate becoming moderate or rough for a time later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then occasional rain developing Sunday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers and rain later.
